knownIssues.title: Race condition in credit deduction
knownIssues.description: Credit deduction is not atomic, allowing concurrent requests to exploit the system
knownIssues.impact: Users can abuse system for free posts, revenue loss
knownIssues.recommendedFix: Implement atomic check-and-deduct using SQL WHERE clause
knownIssues.fixDescription: Implemented atomic SQL-level credit deduction with check-and-deduct in single operation. New deductCreditsAtomic() function uses WHERE credits >= amount clause to ensure atomicity. Credits are now deducted BEFORE posting with automatic refunds for failed posts.

knownIssues.title: Inconsistent JSON parsing
knownIssues.description: 18 API routes lack consistent error handling for malformed JSON
knownIssues.impact: Poor user experience with 500 errors instead of 400 Bad Request

knownIssues.title: Job log deletion bug (POPIA compliance)
knownIssues.description: JSONB query fixed to properly delete job logs on account deletion
knownIssues.impact: POPIA compliance issue - job logs not deleted during account deletion
knownIssues.fixDescription: Replaced JSONB equality check with proper JSONB extraction (payload->>'userId'). Added 8 comprehensive tests to verify complete data deletion.

knownIssues.title: Account deletion endpoint lacks rate limiting
knownIssues.description: No rate limiting on account deletion endpoint
knownIssues.impact: Potential DoS via deletion request spam

knownIssues.title: Webhook error swallowing
knownIssues.description: All webhook errors treated as unrecoverable, preventing retries
knownIssues.impact: Lost webhook events for transient failures

knownIssues.title: Transaction data retention not clear to users
knownIssues.description: Account deletion retains transactions for 7 years but users not informed
knownIssues.impact: POPIA compliance and user trust issue

knownIssues.title: Token decryption debug logging
knownIssues.description: Debug logging exposes partial encryption key and token information

knownIssues.title: NPM dependency vulnerabilities
knownIssues.description: 6 moderate/low npm vulnerabilities in dev dependencies and transitive dependencies: esbuild SSRF (via drizzle-kit), undici resource exhaustion (via @vercel/blob), and 2 low-severity react-router issues
knownIssues.impact: Minimal - all vulnerabilities are in dev/build dependencies or server-side only code with mitigations in place

details.esbuild: Dev dependency only, not used in production. Waiting for drizzle-kit upstream fix.
details.undici: Server-side only via @vercel/blob, trusted endpoints, rate limited. Waiting for @vercel/blob upstream fix.
details.documentation: SECURITY.md contains full risk assessment and mitigation strategies

knownIssues.mitigation: All vulnerabilities documented in SECURITY.md with risk assessments. Monthly monitoring in place via npm audit scripts.
